behavior: A visitor signs in with Privy and lands in the app shell
acceptance: Privy sign-in (email code; Google and passkey enabled in the dashboard) leads to /app with sidebar, top bar, profile switcher and theme switcher; the first sign-in calls POST /v1/me and the personal profile exists
A signed-out visit to /app goes to sign-in; Playwright signs in with the Privy test account (credentials only in the ignored apps/web/.env)
notes: 2026-10-09 review pass by reviewer: Independent review: sign-in, /app auth gate, same-origin /api/v1 rewrite and Privy scoping hold; error and empty states offer Retry and Sign out and the live spec proves it; turbo hashes .env* and API_URL; docs match the code. Open low: rejected logout() is not caught; proof 1's database claim is not checked by the spec.

proof.1: e2e: e2e/privy/sign-in.spec.ts on localhost:3000 with the real Privy app and backend api: the test account signs in by email code, POST /api/v1/me answers 200 (201 on a first sign-in; first signup is covered by backend tests), and /app shows the App navigation, the Profile switcher with Personal, the wallet address, a working theme switch and sign out; a reload still lists one Personal profile; axe finds no serious or critical violation on the real /sign-in and on /app
proof.2: e2e: the live spec checks a signed-out visit to /app goes to /sign-in, also after sign out, and that a failing POST /v1/me shows an error with Sign out; the test account is read only from the ignored apps/web/.env (names in .env.example) and the live run is skipped without it, as in CI, where a11y.spec only audits the not-configured /sign-in

review.summary: Independent review: sign-in, /app auth gate, same-origin /api/v1 rewrite and Privy scoping hold; error and empty states offer Retry and Sign out and the live spec proves it; turbo hashes .env* and API_URL; docs match the code. Open low: rejected logout() is not caught; proof 1's database claim is not checked by the spec.
